summary: Master hotel revenue management with forecasting, pricing, and KPI tools. Build practical strategies and apply them in 5 days. Enroll today.
lede: Hotel revenue management turns booking and demand data into pricing, forecasting, and inventory decisions for hotel teams. Designed for professionals responsible for rates, forecasts, channel performance, or revenue reporting, the course covers KPI analysis, pace forecasting, and distribution controls. You’ll practice calculating ADR, RevPAR, and GOPPAR, building an Excel demand forecast, and assessing group displacement and channel profitability.
audienceIntro: This course is built for hotel professionals who already work with occupancy, room rates, and booking data and need to make stronger commercial decisions. It suits people responsible for daily pricing, forecast preparation, revenue analysis, channel performance, and leadership reporting. Revenue Managers who need sharper pricing and forecasting control. Reservations Managers handling rate loading and booking pace decisions. Rooms Division Managers balancing inventory, occupancy, and profitability. Commercial Analysts preparing KPI and pickup reports. Hotel Finance Managers reviewing revenue performance and forecast gaps. Distribution Managers managing OTAs, direct channels, and parity. Sales Directors negotiating group business and displacement impact. General Managers who need credible revenue reporting for ownership. Pricing Coordinators maintaining rate structures and stay controls. Revenue Analysts supporting demand models and dashboard reporting.
prerequisites: A laptop with spreadsheet software is required for forecasting, KPI, and pricing exercises. You should bring a willingness to work with hotel reports, sample demand data, and property-level commercial scenarios.
